# Platform team budget 2027

The approved budget for 2027 is 45,000 euros for tools and services, not counting
salaries. That is ten percent less than in 2026, because the old monitoring
contract ends in February and is not renewed.

Hiring: one backend developer from April, paid from the central headcount pool
and not from this budget. The job ad goes out in January. A working student for
the documentation was asked for but not approved; we can apply again in July.

Cloud costs are the largest line: about 2,100 euros a month for the build
servers and storage. To stay within budget we move the nightly test runs to the
office machines and delete build artefacts older than ninety days.
